ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-grey pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity black pixel borders and localized focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-intensity field across both lobes. Continuous dark pixel banding along the trailing edge boundary. Discrete low-intensity clusters (blobs) are mapped to the lower-central region and the right-inner lobe near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle approximately between 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; significant peak-to-valley amplitude variance observed at the distal tips compared to the inner lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the lower boundary transitioning to a concave sweep toward the serrated trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters observed on the extreme lateral tips (both left and right) and small circular punctate markings on the lower-central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 distinct, parallel vertical linear markings (rake marks) located on the inner right lobe, breaking the light pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical rake mark scars on the right lobe; irregular trailing edge morphology suggestive of past physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific vertical parallel scar orientation on the inner right lobe adjacent to the notch.
